findings.message: Carried N09 F-3, severity confirmed minor. sdd.md 10 asks for structured (JSON) per-request logs with request id, method, route template, status, duration and user id. Under the logstash format the line is JSON and requestId and userId are fields, but method, route, status and durationMs are text inside the message string. Operability only, no client-visible behaviour; a partial departure from sdd.md 10 to list in the PR.
findings.suggestion: Emit them as key-value pairs (SLF4J addKeyValue) or MDC entries in a follow-up; this also lets FilterExceptionTest select the line by status and retire the newRequestId loop (N09 F-1).

findings.message: Carried N10 F-17, severity confirmed minor. Traced: toggling is cleared in finally once the PUT resolves, before the re-query shows, so a second toggle B can start, and the re-query of A then clears the requested state of B while PUT B is in flight (visible revert). A third click then reverses what the screen shows, and the last re-query always follows the last PUT, so the stored and shown end state match what the user last saw and asked for. A transient flicker, not a REQ-TODO-005 or REQ-DATA-002 failure.
findings.suggestion: Reset dropRequestedOnShow at the start of toggle or tag requested with a toggle sequence number checked in show, with a tests-node case: a second click before the re-query keeps its requested state until its own re-query.

findings.message: Commit messages break the semantic rule (type(scope): summary): 7c949e3, 78ab0c4, b28c58d and 97247fe are titled specs updated (human-authored; they edit frozen requirements.md and sdd.md between the freeze 8a2f087 and the re-freeze 2a0d38e, and 97247fe deletes todo-api-v1.yaml, restored by 07404ac); ac7b03e merge N09 implementation has no type; c435410 mixes docs and test in one message. The frozen files at HEAD are the ones the last freeze hashed (N12 spec integrity ok), so this is process hygiene, not a spec breach.
findings.suggestion: Do not rewrite shared history; note it in the PR. Future spec edits go through a draft supersede with a semantic commit, one type per commit.

findings.message: Many build-node commits carry no Harness-Node trailer, for example bf0c889, 9a8751f, 864156b, 10eb534, 0d04f79, 9a85cdc, f9f0e07, 33289ea, 10435e4, a16eb4f (N10) and 24c145c, b57fb3f, 008da32, c7adbc5 (N09). An untagged commit counts for every build node, so per-node attribution of the delta is weaker than the implementation-plan rule intends; the plan Departures do record each changed path.
findings.suggestion: End every build-node commit, coder and QA alike, with a Harness-Node trailer naming the node in future changes.

findings.message: A macOS Finder file is committed at docs/specs/CHG-0001/design/architecture/.DS_Store (in 806e33d, complete N05-design-arch), and the root .gitignore has no .DS_Store entry. It is not a design artefact and can leak local file names.

findings.message: NFR-002 AC-1 is deferred, not met: HEAD has no .env.example and README.md is the one-line stub, while sdd.md 11 and the sdd.md 14 NFR-002 review row require both. findings.message: Cross-module checks that passed, by reading: client.ts sends X-Todo-Client on every non-GET and Content-Type only with a body (L66-L77), matching ClientHeaderFilter and the contract; asProblem (L39-L56) needs a numeric status and an errors array, which ProblemWriter L19-L50 always writes; 401 routing (own401 for getSession and logIn) matches sdd.md 4.1; same-origin cookie (HttpOnly, SameSite Strict, Max-Age 8 h) through the Vite proxy; q trimmed on both sides with the shared White_Space set; page clamp reflected by URL replace (TodoListPage L111-L122); order of checks session, header, route, 415, body, validation, ownership (SecurityConfig L54-L60, TodoService L51-L71). Tests preceded code: N07 and N08 red commits before every feat commit; N10 round 2 9a85cdc before f9f0e07 and 33289ea. Evidence matches HEAD: web unchanged since a70f2c8, api since b57fb3f.

JsonSuffixMediaTypeTest pins 415 for application/merge-patch+json and application/vnd.x+json only on createTodo and signUp; logIn, updateTodo and setDone received the same consumes change in d68c4de but no +json case, so a later revert of one of those three annotations would go unnoticed. Minor because the fix is one identical annotation per mapping, read on all five, and the round-1 suggestion asked for exactly these two operations.
findings.suggestion: Through the tests node in a follow-up, extend the SUFFIX_JSON_TYPES loop to logIn, updateTodo and setDone, asserting 415 UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE and no stored change.
